candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: The Environment Agency DTM Time Stamped Tiles archive contains survey-specific bare-earth rasters at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m resolutions depending on the project.
The data is referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and the catalogue records survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model; the stated vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE.
semantic_limits: A DTM tile is only valid for parcel QA when its exact survey date, resolution, transformation, geoid and spatial lineage are retained; catalogue membership alone is insufficient.

candidates.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
verified_facts: The Environment Agency point-cloud archive contains 3D x,y,z returns and attributes, with returns classified into ground and surface-object classes.
Time-stamped DSM and DTM rasters are derived from point-cloud data, but historical archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every surface model.
semantic_limits: Raw point returns or classification metadata cannot silently replace the exact raster lineage used by a parcel result, and unmatched point-cloud coverage must fail closed.
